title: Spreading the Style: Firm Leaders’ Early Life Experiences and Employees’ Behavior and Performance
authors: Nan Jia; Yongxiang Wang; Rongrong Xie; Nianhang Xu
near_miss_reason: Binary treatment (SDY chairperson) switches at securities-firm-specific turnover years with analyst, securities-firm, covered-firm and year FE, but every FE column includes time-varying broker/firm controls and forecast horizon ($controlforecast / $controlvisit); the one column without controls (Table 2 col 1) has no fixed effects. Figure 2 turnover event study also includes controls.
eligible_reason: No reported column combines unit and year FE with no time-varying controls.
design_notes: Analyst-forecast and site-visit samples from CSMAR (2006-2017) merged with hand-collected chairperson biographies of Chinese securities companies. Main regressions: reghdfe y Zhiqing2 $controls, absorb(year scode cohort a_code b_code) vce(cluster scode); heterogeneity by SDY type; shockall (exogenous turnover) subsample; IV via provincial SDY ratio (Zhiqing_Ratio); Figure 2 event study around turnover for analysts with one chairperson change; site-visit DiD with treatpost and SDYsite interactions (Table 8). No csdid code in the main-text do-file despite the full-text Callaway mention.

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls ($controlforecast = broker, firm controls and Horizon) in every FE column; column 1 has no FE
specs.treatment_definition: Zhiqing2 = 1 if the chairperson of the analyst's securities firm in year t had sent-down-youth (SDY) experience; switches at chairperson turnover (both directions)
specs.unit_var: analyst-firm-year observations; FE a_code (analyst), b_code (securities firm), scode (covered firm)
specs.fe: year + scode + cohort + a_code + b_code (progressively added)

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls in all columns; post1 included as separate regressor (event-window design around turnover)
specs.treatment_var: treatpost = treat x post1; tpostmm1-8 event-time bins
specs.treatment_definition: analysts experiencing exactly one chairperson change: treat = 1 if change is non-SDY -> SDY, 0 if non-SDY -> non-SDY; period = year - turnover year, window -4..+3

screener_notes: Screened from package only. Near miss: a no-controls TWFE version could be constructed from the shipped data but is not reported.
data_files_note: README: 'The data provided is for replication of our results. Any other use without our permission is strictly prohibited.'
